_comment: MyIDSan distribution defaults — the identity provider / SSO hub for the kopiv2 suite. Safe to edit. On first run a strong jwt.secret is generated and saved here, a self-signed TLS certificate is generated into ./certs (so the app serves HTTPS on :3001 immediately — browsers show a one-time trust warning on a LAN), a one-time superadmin password is generated and written to INITIAL_ADMIN_LOGIN.txt in the data dir, and a short setup wizard walks you through registering your first relying app. This file lives in the app's data dir; locked out? create an empty RESET_ADMIN file next to it and restart.

sso._comment: myidsan IS the SSO provider. issuer/audience are embedded in the tokens it signs; audience lists every relying app allowed to consume them. internalToken guards the internal introspection endpoint — set a long random value if a relying app cannot share the session cache.

localAuth._comment: An empty password makes the first run generate a strong per-install one (printed to the log and saved to INITIAL_ADMIN_LOGIN.txt). Set LOCAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD to override. Never ship a shared default here.

kerberos._comment: Optional SPNEGO single sign-on for domain-joined machines. Point keytabPath at a keytab exported for servicePrincipal (e.g. HTTP/myidsan.corp.local) — see the deploy README for the SPN/keytab/browser-trust runbook.

login._comment: Optional federated login providers. google/github need internet egress; oidc entries cover intranet IdPs (Keycloak, Authentik, ADFS, ...). LDAP/Active Directory login is configured in the UI under Federation → Directory, not here. Secrets may come from env: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET, OIDC_<KEY>_CLIENT_SECRET.

securityHeaders.contentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self'; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
